svg.text: The Leonine prayers and the recessional · LM-140A–LM-140C · spoken 1962 Low Mass, two servers

g.text: LM-140A
The Leonine prayers begun in plano
ONLY WHEN LEONINE-PRESCRIBED
priest: kneeling · step-1-gospel · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · joined-before-breast
→ descend
path predella-gospel-corner → step-1-gospel
AC1: kneeling · plano-centre · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · joined-before-breast
AC2: kneeling · plano-gospel · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · joined-before-breast
path plano-centre → plano-gospel
chalice @ corporal-back-centre [upright]
last-gospel-card @ mensa-gospel-corner [upright]
missal @ mensa-epistle-corner [priest-reads-facing-left]
UNRESOLVED: Whether any printed text or card is used for the Leonine prayers, and when it is
brought, is not fixed by the approved record beyond the prohibition on fetching one during the
Last Gospel.
UNRESOLVED: The lateral spacing of the two kneeling acolytes behind the priest is not fixed by
the approved record, which settles only that both kneel in plano, one level below him and
slightly behind him.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-ROLE-01, INV-OBJ-01
LM-140B
The Leonine sequence and the servers' posture
ONLY WHEN LEONINE-PRESCRIBED
“Three Ave Maria - Salve Regina - versicle and response - the prayer for the
Church and the conversion of sinners - St Michael - the invocation of the
Sacred Heart three times” (audible)
priest: kneeling · step-1-gospel · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · joined-before-breast
AC1: kneeling · plano-centre · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · joined-before-breast
AC2: kneeling · plano-gospel · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · joined-before-breast
chalice @ corporal-back-centre [upright]
altar-cross @ altar-cross [upright]
AC1: “AC1 leads the responses of the whole Leonine sequence, kneeling.”
AC2: “AC2 leads the responses of the whole Leonine sequence, kneeling.”
UNRESOLVED: The response texts of the Leonine prayers are not fixed by the approved record,
which settles the sequence and the servers' leading of the responses but not their words.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-ROLE-01, INV-OBJ-01
LM-140C
The recessional
priest: walking · plano-centre · faces nave · eyes forward · holding-chalice-both-hands
→ ascend
→ genuflect
→ descend
path plano-centre → predella-centre → plano-centre
AC1: walking · plano-centre · faces nave · eyes forward · joined-before-breast
→ genuflect
→ turn-inward
path plano-centre → plano-centre
AC2: walking · plano-centre · faces nave · eyes forward · joined-before-breast
→ genuflect
→ turn-inward
path plano-gospel → plano-centre
chalice @ Carried by the priest in both hands, veiled. [upright] — by priest
chalice-veil @ Over the chalice in the priest's hands. — by priest
burse @ On the veiled chalice the priest carries out. — by priest
alb @ On the priest. — by both-acolytes
biretta @ Presented to the priest by AC1, if one was worn. — by AC1
missal @ mensa-epistle-corner [priest-reads-facing-left]
UNRESOLVED: Whether a biretta is worn at all is a serving-profile parameter; the approved record
settles only that AC1 retrieves and presents it if one was worn.
UNRESOLVED: The priest's exact grip on the veiled chalice during the recessional is not fixed by
the approved record.
UNRESOLVED: When the Missal is closed and removed from the Epistle side after Mass is not fixed
by the approved record.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-ROLE-01, INV-OBJ-01
